title: Love these boxes but they could improve some of the items a bit
text:
I love the jackets/hats and the posters and plates and stuff but the stuffed animal things could improve the quality and the sewing because I’ve gotten a couple of stuffed animals that had holes in them when I open the box.
Also I don’t like that the subscription gets charged at the end of the month because I run out of money by then and this month I had the box get canceled because I didn’t have enough money so I guess I’m not gonna get it this month. I wish it was more at the beginning of the month rather then around the 25th.
label: positive
